subject: Post-call: MAP draft & SOC2 package milestone (security owners + dates)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Celine Park <celine.park@bluepeak.ai>, Marcus Yoon <marcus.yoon@bluepeak.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: MAP draft & SOC2 package milestone (security owners + dates)

Thanks again for the call earlier — good to meet the BluePeak team. As promised, attaching the first-pass Mutual Action Plan and calling out the security milestone we discussed so it’s easy to slot into your internal tracker. Quick recap + next steps below.

Call recap (2/18):
- Scope: evaluate Redwood Inference for customer-facing analytics APIs (chat + embeddings).
- Primary concerns: security posture (SOC 2 artifacts, network isolation), latency SLOs, data residency.
- Decision criteria: security checklist satisfied + pilot performance within target cost.

Security milestone (MAP excerpt):
1) Redwood provides SOC 2 questionnaire and evidence ask list — owner: Redwood security (Dylan) — deliver by 2026-02-20.
2) BluePeak provides environment details, network diagrams, and confirmation of log retention — owner: BluePeak security (Marcus) — due 2026-03-05.
3) Exchange evidence artifacts (redacted logs, config screenshots, sample audit report) — mutual uploads to shared Drive — due 2026-03-12.
4) Final security sign-off + go/no-go for pilot — target decision date: 2026-03-19.

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.pdf (link in body), I’ll share the SOC2 questionnaire as a separate attachment once Dylan confirms the latest template.

Ask for BluePeak: please confirm the internal owner for the network diagram/logs and whether the 3/12 evidence bundle is realistic. I’d like to propose a 30-minute security sync early next week to walk through the questionnaire.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Subject: Re: Post-call: MAP draft & SOC2 package milestone (security owners + dates)

Thanks Aditya — appreciated the clear MAP breakdown. I’ll own coordination on our side and loop in Marcus as the security reviewer. Marcus — can you confirm your availability for a 30-min sync next week?

Immediate Qs from our security intake:
- Can you confirm the level of detail in the questionnaire (full SOC 2 template vs. short intake)?
- For the evidence bundle, can Redwood confirm whether screenshots (console exports) are acceptable for items like IAM policies and retention settings, or do you require signed audit statements?

We’re also tracking internal procurement timelines — if we can get the evidence by 3/12 we’ll aim for a decision week of 3/15–3/19.

Thanks,
Celine Park
Director, Product Ops | BluePeak Analytics
celine.park@bluepeak.ai | +1 212-555-0890
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -08:00
Subject: SOC 2 questionnaire + evidence list (BluePeak)

Hi all — following up with the artifacts we discussed. I’ve attached the SOC 2 questionnaire we use for MAPs and a compact CSV of evidence asks. Quick notes:

What we’re sending (attachments):
- redwood-soc2-questionnaire.xlsx — full intake questionnaire (control-level yes/no + supporting comments).
- soc2-evidence-asks.csv — one-row-per-evidence item with suggested example files.
- sample-audit-report-template.pdf — example of the format we accept for third-party audit reports.

Key evidence items that require BluePeak action:
- Network topology diagram (PDF) — request: include VPC/subnet, firewall/NAT gateways, and peering details. Due: 2026-03-05 — owner: Marcus Yoon.
- IAM config screenshots (console export or annotated screenshots) — acceptable. Due: 2026-03-05 — owner: Marcus Yoon.
- Log retention statement (policy PDF or KMS/ELK retention config) — Due: 2026-03-05 — owner: Marcus Yoon.

Items Redwood will provide:
- SOC 2 questionnaire filled with our control descriptions (partial). Due: 2026-02-20 — owner: Dylan Brooks.
- Sample redacted logs + retention proof from our hosted environment (redwood-sample-logs.txt). Due: 2026-03-01.
- List of endpoint isolation and data partitioning configuration screenshots. Due: 2026-03-01.

If BluePeak needs the questionnaire in a different format (Form, Confluence, or Google Sheets) say so — we can adapt. I’ll also add the Drive folder and grant Marcus edit access after this thread.

Regards,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-soc2-questionnaire.xlsx; soc2-evidence-asks.csv; sample-audit-report-template.pdf

Thanks Dylan — and thanks Celine/Marcus for the quick replies. Two quick items:

1) Target dates: based on the asks above I’m proposing the MAP security milestone target for decision on 2026-03-19 (this lets both teams complete evidence exchange and have time for follow-up questions). If BluePeak wants an earlier decision window we can accelerate, but I wanted a conservative default to align with procurement cycles.

2) Security sync: propose Tue 2026-02-24 10:00 PT for a 30-min walkthrough of the questionnaire and to clarify evidence formats. I’ll send a calendar invite pending Marcus availability.

HubSpot link to the deal and MAP: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/record/BP-2026-044
Drive (MAP + evidence folder): https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1a2B-map-bluepeak-v1

If all looks good I’ll mark the MAP security row as "In progress" and shoot the invite.

Best,
Aditya

Appreciate the detail, team. I can take point on the network diagram and log retention items — will coordinate with infra and have draft artifacts by 2026-03-05 as requested.

On the format question: screenshots and console exports are fine for IAM and retention. For the audit report, we’ll upload a redacted copy if the template fits our wording — otherwise we’ll provide a signed letter from our compliance vendor.

I’m available for the 2/24 10:00 PT sync. Send the invite and I’ll add our infra lead as needed.
